rationale.A: ~730 m in mixed traffic on Topeliuksenkatu and Haartmaninkatu (40 km/h), unsignalised Haartmaninkatu crossing; 6 lights
rationale.B: Same as A but rides the whole of Topeliuksenkatu in traffic (~920 m)
rationale.C: Quiet Välskärinkatu, then the Hesperia/Paciuksenkatu-side path; no mixed traffic, all arterial crossings signalised; 3 lights; +1 min
rationale.D: Same as C via Kesärannantie, but crosses Paciuksenkatu (50 km/h) without signals; 2 lights
rationale.E: ~710 m in traffic on Nordenskiöldinkatu, Topeliuksenkatu and Haartmaninkatu; 7 lights
rationale.F: Park paths with no mixed traffic, but an unsignalised Mechelininkatu crossing; 2 lights; +2 min
rationale.G: Detour via Mannerheimintie-side tracks; 350 m in traffic including tram-railed Reijolankatu/Haartmaninkatu; 11 lights; +5 min
rationale.H: Long Mannerheimintie-side tracks, 330 m in traffic with tram rails, many crossings; 13 lights; +5 min

notes: C and D are nearly the same route; C is calmer (signalised Paciuksenkatu crossing) and D has one light fewer. Either could serve both cards.
